evidence: With torch=2.13.0+cu130, RotaryEmbedding(dim=32, use_xpos=True) on all-ones tensors produces finite q and non-finite k at seq_len=96; the repro prints {'seq_len': 96, 'k_finite': False, 'k_nan': True, 'k_inf': True, 'k_non_finite_count': 91}.
steps: Created a local venv and installed torch==2.13.0 and einops==0.8.2.
Ran repro.py against the local codebase with RotaryEmbedding(dim=32, use_xpos=True).
Confirmed that seq_len=64 stays finite, but seq_len=96 makes k non-finite.
